jobs.title: Sales Executive -NP
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Nobroker Job 2027is hiring freshers for the Sales Executive -NP role (3 Lacs P.A.) in Noida, Hyderabad & Bengaluru. Check eligibility and apply online today!

New Delhi: India’s leading PropTech platform, NoBroker, has opened online applications for the Sales Executive -NP position for freshers. Listed on the official Naukri recruitment portal, this hybrid role offers a starting package of ₹3 Lacs P.A. across three major Indian job hubs: Noida, Hyderabad, and Bengaluru.

For fresh graduates with 0 years of experience looking to enter a fast-paced startup environment, this Nobroker Job 2027 provides immediate corporate exposure and structured sales training. Interested candidates should check the role details below and submit their profiles online before applications close.

About NoBroker

NoBroker is India’s first PropTech unicorn that connects property owners and tenants/buyers directly without middlemen or brokerage fees. Operating across major metropolitan cities, the company leverages technology and data-driven advisory services to simplify renting, buying, selling, and home services.

Joining NoBroker early in your career gives freshers direct exposure to high-growth startup operations, customer advisory, and performance-driven sales mentorship.

Nobroker Job 2027: Key Highlights

FeatureOfficial Details
Company NameNoBroker

Application PortalOfficial Naukri.com Listing

Role and Responsibilities of Nobroker Job 2027

As a Sales Executive -NP at NoBroker, selected freshers will work within the Sales and Advisory division. Key day-to-day responsibilities include:

  • Customer Advisory: Understand client requirements and guide property owners, tenants, or buyers through NoBroker’s service plans.
  • Lead Follow-Ups: Connect with inbound leads via calls and digital channels to explain product value and convert prospects.
  • Pipeline Management: Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, follow-up schedules, and deal closures in the CRM system.
  • Target Achievement: Meet weekly and monthly sales targets while maintaining high customer satisfaction standards.

Eligibility Criteria of Nobroker Job 2027

Before applying via the official Naukri link, verify that you meet the core eligibility requirements:

Who Can Apply?

  • Experience Level: Strictly open to freshers with 0 to 0 years of experience.
  • Educational Qualification: Graduates from any stream (B.A., B.Com, B.Sc., B.B.A., BCA, B.Tech, or equivalent) from a recognized university can apply.
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal communication and persuasive speaking skills in English and relevant regional languages (Hindi/Telugu/Kannada depending on city).
  • Location Readiness: Candidates must be willing to work in a Hybrid setup in Noida, Hyderabad, or Bengaluru.

How to Apply for Nobroker Job 2027 (Step-by-Step)

Follow these simple steps to submit your application online:

  1. Visit the Official Job Page: Open the verified NoBroker Sales Executive -NP Naukri Listing.
  2. Sign In or Register: Log in to your Naukri account (or create a free fresher profile if you are a new user).
  3. Update Your Resume: Upload an updated PDF resume highlighting your graduation details, communication strengths, and preferred city location (Noida, Hyderabad, or Bengaluru).
  4. Click Apply: Review your contact details and submit your application directly to NoBroker’s recruitment team.

Official Job Apply Link – https://www.naukri.com/job-listings-sales-executive-np-nobroker-noida-hyderabad-bengaluru-0-to-0-years-071026048936?src=seo_srp&sid=17952398282548750_3&xp=17&px=6
